redetectDatesHint: Re-parse capture date/time for existing items from filename, EXIF and file timestamp
redetectDetail: Re-parse capture date/time for all items using filename, photo EXIF and file timestamp (in that priority). Only items that resolve to a date are updated; others keep their current value. Continue?
geoHint: Reverse-geocode GPS-tagged photos to province/city/district and place via Amap (set the Amap key in settings first)
geoDetail: Reverse-geocode all GPS-tagged photos via Amap to fill in province/city/district and place. Items without coordinates stay unchanged. Requests are throttled one by one, so large libraries may take a while. Continue?
geoNoKey: Amap key not set. Please configure it in Settings first
geoOneNone: No GPS data or location could not be resolved
machineCodeHint: Provide this code after purchase to issue a license bound to this device.
proRequired: This feature requires Pro. Activate it in Settings.
featureSingleManage: Add, edit and delete individual media
featureBrowse: Search, filters, sorting and three views
featureMetadata: Tags, ratings, notes and document links
featureSingleImport: Import one URL or workspace asset
featureBatchImport: Batch asset import and local references
amapKeyPlaceholder: Paste your Amap Web Service key
amapKeyHint: Used to reverse-geocode GPS coordinates from photo EXIF into region and place. Leave empty to skip location detection.
amapKeyDoc: How to get: log in to the Amap open platform console, create an app and add a Web Service key (with basic services / geocoding). The key is stored only in local plugin data.
mountHint: Scan a local disk directory and reference its images/videos via file:// without copying. Desktop only.
confirmRemoveMount: Unbind auto-scan for this folder? Existing items and annotations are kept, and disk files are not deleted.
confirmPruneDetail: Rescan found {count} entries whose local files were deleted or moved. These records will be removed from the library (their tags, notes, ratings, etc. will be lost too). Existing files on disk are not affected. Continue?
batchImportHint: Pick multiple images/videos, copy into workspace assets
batchLocalHint: Pick multiple local files, reference via file:// without copying
pathUnavailable: Cannot get file path; local files may be unsupported here
emptyHint: Nothing here yet. Click "New" to add image or video
deleteItemChoiceDetail: Choose a deletion mode. Removing only keeps the source file, but permanently deletes this media's tags, notes, rating, date, and links.
deleteFolderChoiceDetail: This folder and all descendants contain {count} media items. Removing only keeps source files, but permanently deletes their tags, notes, ratings, dates, and links.
confirmRecordsOnly: Remove {count} records from the library? Source files stay, but tags, notes, ratings, dates, and links are permanently lost.
confirmDeleteSources: Process {count} records? Local files go to system trash, plugin assets are deleted, and links only lose their records. Folder operations include all descendants.
unsafeLocalPath: The file is outside registered mounts or its path is unsafe; source deletion was refused
unsafeAssetPath: The plugin asset path is unsafe or deletion failed
tagPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter
needFile: Please choose a file to import
needPath: Please fill in the local file path
assetEditHint: File is not re-uploaded in edit mode; delete and recreate to replace
